items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the band that J. J. played with, Benny Carter – we passed back through Cincinnati

ctx.x: Yeah, sent for Gaston. Gaston was an all-around musician. He taught me how to write, in the hospital, because I remember coming back. We played – when we went to Cincinnati, or we passed through – the band that J. J. played with, Benny Carter – we passed back through Cincinnati, and I got a chance to see Gaston. He had already begun to get – lose weight.

items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, I met George Russell with Benny Carter. He was Benny Carter’s drummer for a while and a very good drummer.

ctx.x: Did you meet George Russell across this time? I can't remember if George was on . . .
Yeah, I met George Russell with Benny Carter. He was Benny Carter’s drummer for a while and a very good drummer.
He said 'till Max [Roach] made him give it up.
